C. Na+ (sodium ion): Sodium (Na) has atomic number 11, so it has 11 electrons. When it loses an electron to form Na+, it has 10 electrons. The electron configuration would be 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6, which matches the given configuration.

D. Ne (neon): Neon has atomic number 10, so it has 10 electrons. Its electron configuration is 1s^2 2s^2 2p^6, which matches the given configuration.
